headline: ATL @ CIN matchup research

NRFI probability rose +13.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Martín Pérez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Michael Harris II, Nathaniel Lowe, Sal Stewart, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Matt McLain, Austin Riley because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
